nodes.name: Precursor Preparation and Mixing
nodes.procedure: Solutions, each containing a single metallic salt, were prepared as precursors... Most metallic salts were dissolved in ethanol to prepare 50 mM solutions. Salts insoluble or with low solubility in pure ethanol (palladium chloride, bismuth chloride, and niobium chloride) were dissolved in aqueous hydrochloric acid solution (37%) to final concentrations of 20 vol% HCl(aq) and 50 mM metallic element concentration in ethanol... The mixing protocol was executed by the 300 μL tip with a fast-mixing rate of 7.56 μL/s to ensure turbulent homogeneous mix.

nodes.name: In situ Electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Each sample was first immersed in the electrolyte for 1 min, and then activated with cyclic voltammetry (CV) for 20 scans (50 mV/s), and linear voltammetry scan for once (10 mV/s). The potential range was from -1.0 V to 0.2 V vs. Hg/HgO. The electrolyte was a mixture of 1.0 M potassium hydroxide (KOH) and 1.0 M potassium formate (HCOOK).

nodes.name: Bulk Nanoparticle Synthesis
nodes.procedure: CTAC (50 mg) and oleylamine (5 mL) were mixed and sonicated for about 15 min... Pd(acac)2, Pt(acac)2, Cu(acac)2, HAuCl4, Ir(acac)3, NbCl5, Ce(acac)3·xH2O, Cr(acac)3, glucose (60 mg), and Mo(CO)6 (33 mg) were added... The mixture was then sonicated for 1 h. The vial was then heated to 220 °C and then kept at this temperature for 2 h under vigorous magnetic stirring. The black colloidal product was collected by centrifugation and washed at least twice with a mixture of ethanol and cyclohexane (1:1 in volume ratio). Then, the product was ultrasonicated in 0.5 M acetic acid (in ethanol) for 2 h and then centrifuged to further remove organic impurities.
